title: OBI build package
description: A named list of sources that are built together with their dependent objects. The file name is the name of the package.

archived.description: Done (e.g. merged): hidden in the Build packages view unless archived packages are shown. It can still be built.

sources.description: Sources of the package, relative to the source directory. They are always built, also if they didn't change.

items.patternErrorMessage: A source in the form lib/file/member.ext, e.g. mylib/qrpglesrc/hello.rpgle.pgm
